def regression_diff({{baseline}}, {{candidate}}):
    diffs = []
    for k in {{baseline}}:
        b, c = {{baseline}}[k], {{candidate}}.get(k)
        if c is None: continue
        diffs.append((k, c - b))
    regressions = [d for d in diffs if d[1] < -0.02]
    return diffs, regressions
